cases.name: test-dispatch-builtins-normal-1
cases.description: Verify normal routing of a recognized internal command.
cases.expected_behavior: The system intercepts the command and executes the internal handler.

cases.name: test-dispatch-builtins-fallback-1
cases.description: Verify fallback behavior for unrecognized command names.
cases.expected_behavior: Unrecognized commands bypass the router and attempt external process execution.

cases.name: test-dispatch-builtins-edge-1
cases.description: Verify handling of empty or blank input lines during routing evaluation.
cases.expected_behavior: Empty input strings are safely ignored without triggering errors or false matches.

cases.name: test-dispatch-builtins-oracle-1
cases.description: Verify dynamic routing consistency across varied input sequences.
cases.expected_behavior: The command router correctly distinguishes internal commands from external binaries across randomized execution sequences.
